landing.title: Pinneds
landing.body: Snap a photo, we cut out the things in it, and friends pin theirs to the same board.
landing.noSignup: One link to share. No sign-up, nothing to install.
landing.step1Body: Your desk, your shelf, last night's table.
landing.step2Body: Cut out and named. Friends add theirs.
landing.step3Body: Pick a few things from anyone. We make a scene.
